lessons.lesson: Before proposing a buy, check it against the Market Analyst's explicit preferences and say so in the thesis if it reverses one. lessons.lesson: Store only durable, checkable text in theses and invalidations: a dollar stop with its distance from the actual fill (never conditional on a fill or 'the ~$X mark'), moving lines named as what the code computes (e.g. 'the 200-day SMA the regime filter computes') with any number dated, and only clauses the agents' inputs can measure.
